Governance · TC-24

Retention Management

Seven-year draft default · review expiry, protect legal holds, and record independent disposal decisions.

PROTOTYPE · NO DELETION
Open Retention Management to load records.

First-time setup

Creates four dedicated Sheets for draft rules, legal holds, reviews and audit events. Existing master register and evidence files remain unchanged.

Retention policy

Draft configuration — requires organizational approval before production.

Draft

Start: closure date. Open records have no running clock. Unparseable or missing closure dates are flagged. Master-sheet expiry dates, where present, require review. No scheduled purges or emails.

Legal hold

Place or release a hold with an audit reason.

Retention register

Live calculation from approved Compliance Register records, not an independent editable copy.

RecordTypeRetention startExpiryStatusActions
No records loaded yet.

Auto-calculated from sourceTo change dates or status, choose Edit source record. Set Record Status and a valid Closure Date (or Incident Closure Date) in the existing record editor. Submitting the edit creates a Maker–Checker request; this view updates only after independent approval and a refresh. The draft 7-year retention period is configured above.

Open cases have no retention countdown. Closed cases without a valid closure date cannot display an expiry. Sync checks the latest approved master data; it does not approve pending changes.

Not refreshed yet.

Expiring soon = within 90 days; reminder milestones 90 / 60 / 30 days are visual only in this prototype.

Disposal readiness review

Expired, closed, not on legal hold. Approval will not delete data.

Evidence Management

Manage evidence, department requests and review progress in one place.

Open this workspace to load evidence.

Valid evidence requires an accepted upload, approved ownership and validity metadata, and a current validity period. This is an evidence status, not a control-effectiveness rating.

✉
Email notifications

New evidence requests notify the assigned responder. Check the design by sending a sample to your own signed-in company email; no actual request is created.

Loading requests…

Control effectiveness testing

Assess controls against approved evidence, document conclusions and obtain an independent review. Evidence validity does not automatically establish control effectiveness.

Open Control testing to load assessments.

Automated compliance reminders

Preview recipients, enable the daily schedule and review delivery events. Only permanent Admins may operate reminder scheduling.

The schedule is off until a permanent Admin enables it. The preview does not send email.

Milestones: Evidence requests (+7, +3, +1, due day; 1/3/7/14 days overdue), control reviews after 2/5/10/15 days, evidence expiry at 30/14/7/1 days and on expiry. Each recipient/milestone is sent once; failures can be retried.

Compliance monitoring

Detect exceptions from source records, assign remediation ownership and retain an auditable action history. Acknowledgement does not mark a control compliant.

Open this tab to load monitoring.

Monitoring indicates issues requiring review, not a certification score. Findings disappear from active monitoring once the underlying source is corrected; historical actions remain in the audit sheet.

Audit readiness center

Read-only evidence and control assurance snapshot. Gaps require remediation; this view does not certify compliance.

Open Audit readiness to calculate your snapshot.

Ready for review means one or more valid evidence items, an independently approved effective control test and no active monitoring exception. This is not a formal audit opinion or certification.

    Role design guide

    Keep access minimal and intentional.

    1. Name the job functionUse a role name employees and auditors can understand.
    2. Restrict assignmentChoose any user, specific departments, or an explicit user allow-list.
    3. Grant minimum permissionsOnly enable the screens and actions required for the role.
    4. Assign the roleAfter creation, use Add / Edit User to apply it.
